# SmartDraw

> SmartDraw is an enterprise visual collaboration platform for creating scaled floor plans, flowcharts, org charts, and diagrams with AI-powered generation and seamless integrations.

SmartDraw serves enterprises and professionals across construction, IT, HR, and education with alternatives to Visio, Lucidchart, and Miro. The platform emphasizes data control, real-time collaboration, and compliance certifications including SOC2 Type II and GDPR.

## Key Topics

- Floor Plans & Scaled Drawings
- AI Diagram Generation
- Enterprise Solution
- Real-Time Collaboration
- Microsoft Integration (Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint)
- Google Workspace Integration
- Data Control & Security
- SSO & Single Sign-On
- Jira & Confluence Integration
- Visio Alternative
- Custom Data & Manifests
- Compliance (SOC2, GDPR, CCPA)
- Construction & OSHA Compliance
- Whiteboarding & Diagram Generation
- Third-Party Storage Integration

## Core Platform & Features

- [SmartDraw | Easy Floor Plans and Other Layouts](https://www.smartdraw.com): SmartDraw homepage showcasing floor plans, flowcharts, org charts and diagramming capabilities
- [Easy Scaled Drawings Without CAD Complexity | SmartDraw's Floor Plan Creator Features](https://www.smartdraw.com/floor-plan/easy-scaled-drawings.htm): Floor plan creator feature overview with drag-and-drop scaled drawing tools
- [Import and Scale Existing Images | SmartDraw's Floor Plan Creator Features](https://www.smartdraw.com/floor-plan/import-and-scale.htm): Feature enabling import and scaling of PDFs, Google Maps, and images for floor plans
- [Create Custom Shapes and Libraries | SmartDraw's Floor Plan Creator Features](https://www.smartdraw.com/floor-plan/custom-shapes-libraries.htm): Custom shapes and shared libraries for design standardization and team collaboration
- [Add Custom Data and Generate a Manifest | SmartDraw's Floor Plan Creator Features](https://www.smartdraw.com/floor-plan/data-enabled.htm): Data-driven floor plans with custom data attachment and manifest generation
- [AI Diagramming | Go from Prompt to Diagram Instantly with Diagramming AI](https://www.smartdraw.com/ai/generate-diagrams-with-ai.htm): AI-powered diagram generation from text prompts for flowcharts and org charts
